ValidationRule.description: Restrict Level 1 users from selecting future date in IDR cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'General_Inquiry_CMOS' ), IDR_Date_Received__c > NOW() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot select a future date
